nodemode.reason: NodeMode type alias maps to A14-deferred mode-mutation surface; returns in Phase B.

nodemodechangedevent.reason: Mode-change event payload is A14-deferred; wired up alongside getMode/setMode in Phase B.

nodeconnectedevent.reason: Slot-level connect event is A14-deferred; ships with slot-mutation surface in Phase B.

nodedisconnectedevent.reason: Slot-level disconnect event is A14-deferred; ships with slot-mutation surface in Phase B.

nodepositionchangedevent.reason: Position-change event is A14-deferred; returns with position accessors in Phase B.

nodesizechangedevent.reason: Size-change event is A14-deferred; returns with size accessors in Phase B.

slotinfo.reason: Slot connection enumeration is A14-deferred (W17.A audit); returns with slot surface in Phase B.

slotdirection.reason: Slot direction enum is A14-deferred; returns with slot surface in Phase B.
